title: Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) Enrollment Eligibility Schedule
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Enrollment Eligibility Schedule

This schedule gives, tier by tier, the entry conditions for Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI): the SGLI coverage a member must have held at separation to take a given tier, how long after SGLI coverage ends an application is taken, the characters of discharge with which an SGLI-insured member may obtain VGLI, and the limits on the amount of initial coverage.

## Entry conditions by tier

| Coverage tier | SGLI coverage held at separation, at least (USD) | Application received within, after SGLI coverage ended | Accepted without health questions within | Accepted with proof of good health within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | 50000 | 485 calendar days | 240 calendar days | 485 calendar days |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | 100000 | 485 calendar days | 240 calendar days | 485 calendar days |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | 200000 | 485 calendar days | 240 calendar days | 485 calendar days |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | 300000 | 485 calendar days | 240 calendar days | 485 calendar days |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | 400000 | 485 calendar days | 240 calendar days | 485 calendar days |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | 500000 | 485 calendar days | 240 calendar days | 485 calendar days |

## Character of discharge

On every tier, SGLI-insured members may obtain VGLI with a discharge characterised as:

- honorable;
- general (under honorable conditions);
- other than honorable.

## Amount of initial coverage

| Limit | Figure, all tiers |
|---|---|
| Lowest VGLI coverage available | USD 10000 ($10,000) |
| Highest VGLI coverage available | USD 500000 ($500,000) |
| Multiple in which coverage is chosen | USD 10000 ($10,000) |
| Ceiling set by SGLI | Initial VGLI coverage cannot exceed the SGLI coverage held at separation |

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical members)

*The members below are hypothetical and illustrate the tier column only.*

- A member who held $200,000 of SGLI coverage at separation meets the SGLI figure for VGLI $50,000 Coverage, VGLI $100,000 Coverage and VGLI $200,000 Coverage, and does not meet it for the $300,000, $400,000 or $500,000 tiers.
- A member who held $500,000 of SGLI coverage at separation meets the SGLI figure for every tier.
- A member who held $100,000 of SGLI coverage at separation cannot take initial coverage above $100,000, because initial coverage cannot exceed the SGLI coverage held at separation.

The two application windows are measured from the date SGLI coverage ended; they are the same on every tier, so the tier chosen never lengthens or shortens them.
